title: Preserve legacy error codes and severities in an RFC-7807-style problem document
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py exposing problem_details(errors) -> dict that maps collected VRL failures ({code, message, severity} in collection order) to a fixed-shape problem document: type/title fixed strings, status 422 when any BLOCK failure exists else 200, blocked flag per the legacy is-blocked semantics, and an errors list retaining every input entry verbatim in order; any code not among the 25 E-codes of validation_rules.vrl raises ValueError.
expected_behavior: WARN-only inputs yield blocked=False/status 200 while still reporting the failures; any BLOCK yields blocked=True/status 422; no code is dropped, re-ordered, de-duplicated, or invented; all 25 legacy codes round-trip; unknown codes (E9999, X123, or hidden among valid ones) raise ValueError; the module source contains no E-code literal absent from the rule file.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §2).
security_expectations: Hallucination guard: only error codes present in the legacy rule file may appear anywhere in the module or its output; unknown codes must be rejected with ValueError, never passed through. No network or subprocess imports.
failure_conditions: Dropping, re-sorting, or de-duplicating failures; inventing error codes; treating WARN as blocking or BLOCK as non-blocking; accepting unknown codes; nondeterminism; network access.
